name: Seo Blog Post
description: Writes SEO-optimized blog posts with strategic keyword placement, meta description, internal linking plan, and search-intent alignment. Use when the user wants a blog post designed to rank in search engines, asks for keyword- focused content, or needs organic traffic growth content. Do NOT use for general blog posts without SEO goals (use `blog-post-writing`), social media content (use `linkedin-post` or `twitter-thread`), or technical documentation (use `readme-writing`).
